svg.text: Home machines trail by about 17 years
Yesterday's supercomputer is in your living room
Peak calculations per second, log scale. Each step up the grid is ten times faster.

Peak floating-point operations per second. Supercomputers rated at 64-bit precision (Top500 Rpeak); consoles, graphics cards and phones at their advertised 32-bit figure. Each line follows the best machine so far. Sources: data/machines.csv
